title: A showcase phase whose only written owners kept their style settles failed; WP sweep keeps pages the map names by address; Akeeba guard files are completed, never written through a link
steps: Run the three suites in run.cmd from the repo root; they drive joomla-bootstrap.php, wordpress.sh, showcase-nav-map.js, wp-residue.js and webroot-skipped-dirs.sh under test doubles.
expect: Joomla and WordPress: a status with conflicts plus only kept mega-menu styles and nothing hidden is a failed phase naming the kept styles, and what it applied is reverted
A status with conflicts plus at least one owner hidden is applied and names the left owners (1 of N)
showcasePageIds resolves a templatePart.removeBlock href against the site pages: JA Kinetic gives 1748 and 1749
An unticked showcase page named only by its address stays published; a non-showcase page is drafted
A half-made Akeeba output folder gets only the guard files it lacks, and only those are printed
A guard file or an output folder that is a link is not written through
A removed template-part link to another host, including the URL parser's own base host, protects no site page
fence: Provisioning scripts and brief engines under test doubles; no live site

tests: owners the status leaves as they were are named; all of them left is a failed phase, not applied
a new site has its template showcase taken out of the menus; skips, losses and refusals are said
WordPress: a link removed from a template part names its page by address, resolved against the site pages
a showcase page the map names only by its address stays published when unticked
a folder made half-way gets the guard files it lacks, and only those are printed
a guard file or an output folder that is a link is not written through
WordPress: a removed template-part link to another host names none of the site pages
